title: Present Perfect or Past Simple: Quiz — Quiz 50
content:
## Present Perfect or Past Simple: Quiz

Choose the tense that suits the time and meaning of each sentence.

### Lesson focus

1. I ___ her to be angry. (never knew / have never known)
2. ___ 'Suraj Pe Mangal Bhari'? (Did you see / Have you seen)
3. Kamalu ___ to London. (went / has been)
4. Kamalu ___ to London yesterday. (went / has gone)
5. ___ any serious illness? (Did you have / Have you had)

### Understand the pattern

Present perfect connects an experience or result with the present. Past simple places an event in a finished past period. Without a time or context clue, more than one choice may be grammatical; explain the intended meaning rather than treating every alternative as inherently wrong.

### Worked answers and explanation

1. Have never known is natural for experience up to now; never knew can describe a finished past period.
2. Have you seen asks about experience; did you see asks about a particular past occasion.
3. Has been normally suggests a completed visit; went needs an understood past occasion.
4. Went fits yesterday.
5. Have you had naturally asks about experience up to now.

### Try another

Choose: I ___ my key yesterday. (lost / have lost)

### Suggested answer

Lost. Yesterday identifies a finished past time, so the ordinary choice is past simple, not present perfect.
